title: A complete classification of singularities for radial solutions of the Stefan problem
summary: We investigate singularities of radial solutions of the classical two-phase and one-phase Stefan problem. In a remarkable result, M.A. Herrero and J.J.L. Velazquez show existence of a solution such that the free boundary described by $g(t)$ satisfies in dimension $n\geq 3$ $$g(t)=c_n \sqrt{t} |\log t|^{\frac{-1}{n - 2}} (1 + o(1)), t\to 0,$$ and they conjecture that these asymptotics hold in general. Here we prove the conjecture for all radial solutions, which means complete asymptotic rigidity in that class. In order to obtain these precise asymptotics for the two-phase Stefan problem, for…
